overviewHtml:
Detecting a problem is only half the job. Remediation and ticket updates still depend on manual hand-offs between tools.

What you get

  • Variant with Ansible Automation Controller: ServiceNow incident, DQL-found remediation, job template launch
  • Result comments on the incident and the problem, plus a Slack message to the owning team
  • Variant with Event-Driven Ansible: load forecast with Davis AI and a rulebook-triggered playbook
  • A step-by-step tutorial notebook
prereqsHtml:
• Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows and Notebooks
  • Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform (Automation Controller and/or Event-Driven Ansible)
  • From Dynatrace Hub: Red Hat Ansible for Workflows, ServiceNow for Workflows and Slack for Workflows, each with a connection
  • The hosts of your systems in the allowed outbound connections. Use EdgeConnect if they are behind a firewall.
  • Ownership teams on your entities, used for targeted notifications
setupHtml:
1. In Notebooks, choose Import and select red-hat-tutorial.notebook.json. Follow it step by step.
  2. Create the connections to Red Hat Ansible, ServiceNow and Slack.
  3. In Workflows, choose Upload and import the workflow template(s) for the variant you want. Assign the connections when prompted.
  4. For variant 2, deploy rulebook.yml and playbook.yml in Event-Driven Ansible.
  5. Use the notebook to ingest a test event and watch the remediation run.
getStartedHtml:
You need Dynatrace Workflows, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform and connections for ServiceNow and Slack.

  1. Import the tutorial notebook and follow it
  2. Create the Ansible, ServiceNow and Slack connections
  3. Upload the workflow templates for your variant
  4. Ingest a test event and watch the remediation
